source_note_en: The certifying body releases no past exam items; every item here is a blueprint-based original for practice only.

references.zh: 示例考试蓝图 / Demo blueprint

blocks.zh: 风险评价与优先级排序
points: 先定义可接受标准，再排序：后果严重度 × 可能性，两者都打分再比
Set acceptance criteria first, then rank by severity times likelihood
识别危害要覆盖任务、设备、环境、人员四类输入，缺一类就会漏项
Hazard identification must cover task, equipment, environment and people
控制措施按层级选择：消除、替代、工程、管理、PPE，优先靠前的层级
Apply the hierarchy of controls: eliminate, substitute, engineer, administrate, PPE
剩余风险必须复评并记录，不能以“已采取措施”当作风险已消除
Re-assess and record residual risk; controls applied do not mean risk removed
高风险作业设置书面许可与现场确认两道闸门
High-risk work needs a written permit plus on-site verification
terms: 风险（危害发生的可能性与后果组合）

scenario.zh: 某车间噪声 95 dBA（8 小时班），已发耳塞并培训。按控制层级，下一步最应优先做的是？
scenario.en: A workshop runs at 95 dBA over an 8-hour shift; earplugs have been issued and training done. Per the hierarchy of controls, what should come next first?
options: 增加警示标识并再次培训
对产生噪声的设备做工程改造或隔离（隔声罩、减振、远离工位）
把耳塞更换为更高降噪等级
要求员工签署已知风险确认书
scenario.why_zh: 工程控制位于 PPE 之前：先降低源头噪声，再谈个体防护；标识与培训属管理控制，不能替代工程措施。
scenario.why_en: Engineering controls outrank PPE: reduce noise at source before relying on protection; signs and training are administrative and cannot replace engineering.

practice: 用你现场的一个作业，写出一条可接受风险标准（后果 + 可能性 + 门槛）
Write one acceptance criterion for a task on your site (consequence + likelihood + threshold)
列出三项你单位尚未落实的工程控制，并说明各自能降低哪类风险
List three engineering controls not yet in place and which risk each would reduce
blocks.memory: 先定标准再排序，工程优先于佩戴

blocks.zh: 职业健康危害与暴露控制
blocks.en: Occupational Health Hazards and Exposure Control
points: 健康危害按途径分：吸入、皮肤吸收、食入、注射，控制手段各不相同
Route matters: inhalation, skin, ingestion and injection need different controls
暴露评估先分组（相似暴露组），再做个体采样，定点采样只作补充
Group similar exposure first, then personal sampling; area sampling is supplementary
结果与职业接触限值对比时，注意 8 小时 TWA 与短时接触限值的区别
Compare with the right limit: 8-hour TWA versus short-term exposure limit
呼吸防护是最后一道：先工程控制，再选适合的过滤等级并做密合性测试
Respirators are last: engineer first, then correct filter class plus fit testing
健康监护（体检、听力测试）用于早期发现，不替代暴露控制
Health surveillance detects early effects; it does not replace exposure control

scenario.zh: 工人 4 小时暴露于 60 ppm（限值 8 小时 TWA = 50 ppm），其余 4 小时无暴露。8 小时 TWA 是多少？
scenario.en: A worker is exposed to 60 ppm for 4 hours (8-hour TWA limit 50 ppm) and unexposed for 4 hours. What is the 8-hour TWA?
scenario.why_zh: TWA =（60×4 + 0×4）÷ 8 = 30 ppm，低于 50 ppm 限值；但短时峰值仍需单独评估。
scenario.why_en: TWA = (60*4 + 0*4)/8 = 30 ppm, below the 50 ppm limit; short-term peaks still need separate review.

practice: 写出你现场一个相似暴露组的划分依据（任务、位置、时长）
Describe how one similar exposure group on your site is defined (task, location, duration)
说明本单位的呼吸防护选用流程：从危害识别到密合性测试
Describe your respirator selection flow, from hazard identification to fit testing
blocks.memory: 先分组再采样，限值要对口径
